Brother Blacksmith

Biography

Brother Blacksmith finds Zak after his escape through the caves and speaks for him before Khatul. He fled enslavement after his smithy burned down and maintains secret trade with city merchants to equip the Shelter. He asks Zak to settle an old grievance against the slavedriver brothers Lash-Aga and Whip-Aga, a request that brings him into conflict with Khatul’s caution. [1, 2, 3, 4]
